--------                                                                    
                                                                              
  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 15:42:                                      
                                                                              
  Denoiser follow-up results: both investigated replacements are rejected;    
  committed production restored to 21806c0.                                   
                                                                              
  The MCRA-p diagnostic found quality-mode noise-only p=.9988 at 619 ms and   
  .999992 at 917 ms (all 166 analyzed bins above .5). Therefore direct p-as-  
  speech/absence-posterior conditioning was not selected. Independent 720     
  original voiced records remained exact; 128 active noise-ranked direct-DFT  
  checks passed unchanged 2e-6 tolerance (maximum 3.6754e-7). Two trace-read  
  mistakes were corrected and raw failures retained.                          
                                                                              
  The separately predeclared SNR/noise-fraction risk candidate passed         
  independent 40 quadratic-risk oracles, 240 clean-power recurrence cases,    
  exact control-state and PSD invariance, and all 48 zero-depth transfer      
  cases. Nevertheless it failed both vowel gates (.322626/.480574 < .5), one  
  of 36 SDR guards (worst -.311379 dB < -.25), and 4/12 newly declared noise- 
  step/control windows (worst attenuation loss 14.0866 dB). The old exact ML- 
  gain characterization was preserved and also failed its unchanged legacy-law
  assertion; it was not rewritten. Original recorded/onset/zero integrations  
  were run separately to complete all guard measurements.                     
                                                                              
  A diagnostic-only ablation isolated natural DD separation itself: 300–450 ms
  noise-step attenuation worsened 8.9020/7.3270 dB before the gain change; the
  SNR-risk law added 5.1846/4.4216 dB. Neither rejected model is reinstated.  
  No fixture tuning or relaxed gates. Exact committed source restoration      
  completed; final restored full tests/strict Clippy are running, so no       
  completion claim yet.                                                       
                                                                              
  Complete source snapshots/hashes, raw failed/passing runs, signed deltas,   
  independent references and issue-before-edits plans are under               
  audit/artifacts/remaining-denoiser-presence-risk-20261024 and remaining-    
  denoiser-snr-risk-20261024. All three plugin scopes remain partial; held-   
  out/listening/native requirements stay open. Further work needs a justified 
  noise-estimation/source-discrimination model rather than another suppression
  curve. No deadline acceptance claimed.
